messages: Maya Chen: Quick design pass on progressive render for the playground stream: I tried a 'Freeze response' affordance instead of 'Stop' — the idea is to make it clear we keep the partial output as the snapshot, not 'abort' state. Opinions? Devin Patel: I like the mental model. Two quick asks: keyboard shortcut (Esc vs Cmd+.) and what happens if user taps freeze then regenerate? do we replace the frozen content or append new message? Maya Chen: Good q — propose we append a new message when regenerating, keep the frozen one intact (like a snapshot). Shortcut: Esc toggles live/paused, Cmd+. opens the overflow menu. Sasha Rivera: UX nit: if we append new message we need a clear affordance to 'merge' or 'replace' so users don't get confused with chat history. Also accessibility: freezing should expose an explicit aria-live change so screen reader users know stream paused and a snapshot is available. Alan Ng: For token counter placement — I'm leaning toward putting a compact token pill in the message footer (right-aligned) showing just the token count for that message. Hover expands to cost estimate. Keeps header cleaner. Jyoti Rao: Accessibility nits for token pill: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 and it's keyboard focusable. Also include aria-label like 'Message tokens: 42' and make sure it's not read on every partial update (that would be noisy). Devin Patel: Agree. Implementation thought: use aria-live="polite" on the overall stream container, but when we show token updates we should update an offscreen region with aria-hidden toggle so SR users can query final token count on demand. Maya Chen: Sketches posted here: https://figma.com/s/mini-shelf-proto (preview). Key screens: live stream, frozen snapshot, regenerate flow, mini-prompt-shelf. Please review microcopy: current labels are 'Freeze response', 'Regenerate', 'Resume stream', 'Replace snapshot'. Sasha Rivera: Microcopy tweaks: prefer 'Save snapshot' instead of 'Freeze response' — sounds clearer for non-dev users. 'Resume' ok. 'Replace snapshot' maybe 'Overwrite snapshot' is stronger. Maya Chen: Hmm I wanted to avoid the word 'save' because it suggests persistent storage. 'Snapshot' + 'Save' could be confusing. Maybe 'Capture snapshot'? Alan Ng: 'Capture snapshot' reads well. 'Capture' also suggests moment-in-time. Jyoti Rao: For A11y, if we use 'Capture snapshot' ensure the tooltip includes context: 'Capture a static copy of the current response for review. Keyboard: Esc'. Devin Patel: Edge case: user with streaming enabled and a long response — we should prevent accidental capture double-taps. Add a brief 300ms debounce and an animation so it's obvious capture happened. Playground Bot: TokenEstimator: estimated tokens for last partial: 48 tokens (words -> 38). Cost est: $0.00024. Maya Chen: Nice. Can we style bot message inline as a tiny status chip and exclude it from history export by default? Sasha Rivera: Export concerns: snapshots should be included, bot status chips probably not. Add a toggle in export settings: include system metadata / exclude system metadata. Alan Ng: Implementation: footer pill HTML prototype: `` plus visually-hidden `Estimated cost $0.00024` toggled on hover/focus. Jyoti Rao: Make sure the pill is reachable by keyboard and the description doesn't auto-speak unless focused. Use `aria-describedby` linking to the hidden cost text. Maya Chen: Prompt shelf: proposing a mini-shelf that slides from the left, shows pinned prompts, and supports drag-to-pin. We should support screen-reader accessible labels per prompt and keyboard nav (arrow keys + Enter to insert). Devin Patel: Also think about filtering — typed filter should be debounced 200ms. When user inserts prompt, show a small toast 'Prompt inserted' with undo option. Sasha Rivera: Undo affordance is critical. Microcopy: toast text 'Inserted prompt — Undo' (link). Also verify focus management: after insert, focus should remain in the composer. Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Dev implement capture debounce + animation (Alan/Devin) 2) Token pill prototype + aria-described (Alan/Jyoti) 3) Microcopy update: 'Capture snapshot' and toast wording (Sasha/Maya) 4) Mini prompt-shelf keyboard nav + undo toast (Devin/Sasha) 5) Add export toggle for system metadata (Product ops). Alan Ng: I'll take 1 & 2, prototype by EOD tomorrow. Devin Patel: I'll do 4 and wire up the keyboard shortcut mapping. Jyoti Rao: I'll write the a11y acceptance criteria and examples. Sasha Rivera: I'll draft the microcopy and the toast copy. Maya Chen: Thanks all — if no blockers I'll update figma and push a small spec this afternoon. :sparkles:
